capabilities: : Anchor files or folders to fixed positions
: Maintain live sorting for unanchored items
: Manage anchors via drag and drop
: Control anchors using right-click menus and commands
extras: Warning: Do not use with other plugins that reorder the file explorer, such as Custom File Explorer sorting or Explorer Order Editor.
intentEvidence: Keep Obsidian's own file explorer sorting (for example Modified time, new to old) running automatically, and anchor only the items you choose to a fixed spot.
problem: Users lose the fixed placement of important files when the file explorer automatically reorders items based on criteria like modification time.
summary: Anchored Sort allows users to fix specific files or folders in a fixed position within the Obsidian file explorer while maintaining the dynamic live sorting of all other items.
